youtube.title: ₹1 Lakh, 2 Log: Ek Ne Udaaya, Ek Ne Badhaaya #Shorts
youtube.description:
Same ₹1 lakh, do alag faisle: ek ne kharch kiya, doosre ne pehle emergency fund banaya aur baaki lambe time ke liye invest kiya. Compounding ka simple example, Hinglish mein.

Is video ke numbers (illustration, guarantee nahi):
• 12% per year maan kar: ₹1 lakh x 1.12^10 ≈ ₹3.1 lakh (10 saal), x 1.12^20 ≈ ₹9.6 lakh (20 saal)
• Returns market ke hisaab se upar-neeche hote hain; 12% sirf example hai

Aapko ₹1 lakh mile toh pehla kaam kya karoge? 👇

📌 Sirf educational content. SEBI-registered nahi. Investment advice nahi.
